chunks: Integrating the Numbers Protocol with Arcium gives a strong architecture for private AI media provenance, verification, and confidential content execution: developers manage, verify, and track digital media without ever exposing the underlying files or private metadata. Source: https://docs.arcium.com/developers/arcis/types

Arcium relies strictly on a decentralized Multi-Party Computation (MPC) engine via its Cerberus protocol — not hardware-based Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs). It mathematically splits and encrypts data across a network of independent Arx nodes, unlike TEE models such as Intel SGX or AMD SEV. Source: https://docs.arcium.com/developers/arcis/types

Confidential provenance indexing: Numbers Protocol uses open-source standards like ERC-7053 to track full history, authorship, and licensing of digital media; routing these indexes through Arcium's Multiparty Computation Execution Environments (MXEs) keeps sensitive metadata and raw pixels encrypted during processing. Source: https://docs.arcium.com/developers/arcis/types

Privacy-preserving AI training and inference: Arcium's Blackthorn confidential AI engine reads media registries from Numbers Protocol, letting models verify content authenticity or check AI-usage permissions on encrypted inputs without exposing copyright-protected artwork to node operators. Source: https://docs.arcium.com/developers/arcis/types

Encrypted cross-chain verification: Numbers Protocol acts as an EVM-compatible indexing library while Arcium runs natively as an encrypted execution layer on Solana; a multi-chain bridge or oracle framework uses Arcium to process encrypted inputs against Numbers' on-chain birth certificates for images and video, bringing secure verification to Solana applications. Source: https://docs.arcium.com/developers/arcis/types

UZE relevance: Numbers Protocol secures the data layer for fractional attribution and programmatic revenue/income share derived from on-chain cryptographic proofs of provenance to the owner/originator — the provenance backbone for GIRA creator IP protection. Numbers is the sole infra vendor permitted by name in public UZE surfaces. Source: UZE treasury spec
